definition: Adam Tauman Kalai is an American computer scientist who specializes in artificial intelligence.
details: He was a researcher at OpenAI from 2023 to 2026 and is a cofounder of the Institute for Responsible Superintelligence (RESI).

explainer.lead: Adam Tauman Kalai is an American computer scientist at OpenAI who works on machine learning theory, fairness in AI and why language models hallucinate.
explainer.knownFor: Showing that word embeddings encode gender bias (2016), and explaining the statistical reasons language models hallucinate.

contributions.name: Bias in word embeddings
contributions.detail: Co-wrote “Man is to Computer Programmer as Woman is to Homemaker?”, which measured gender stereotypes in embeddings and proposed a way to remove them.

contributions.name: Why models hallucinate
contributions.detail: “Calibrated Language Models Must Hallucinate” (2023, with Santosh Vempala) proved that well-calibrated pretrained models will invent rare facts.

contributions.name: Fixing the incentives
contributions.detail: OpenAI’s “Why Language Models Hallucinate” (2025) argues benchmarks reward guessing over admitting uncertainty.

contributions.name: Learning theory
contributions.detail: Earlier theoretical work on online and agnostic learning at TTIC, Georgia Tech and Microsoft Research.

timeline.what: Postdoc at MIT, then faculty at the Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago

keyWorks.title: Man is to Computer Programmer as Woman is to Homemaker? Debiasing Word Embeddings
